description: Stop an automation for good: every future run is cancelled. Orders already running finish, unless cancel_running: true asks those that allow it to cancel too (the undelivered part is refunded). Confirm with the user first.

automation.description: The automation number (the `id` of an automation, e.g. 2001).

cancel_running.description: Also ask its running orders to cancel.

name: cancel_automation
title: Cancel an automation
